rules: Do not replace accepted hardware merely because historical source is inconvenient.
Persist source, commands, results and report for every experiment.
Do not label model/process data as fabricated measurement.
Coherent quantum memory is not part of the current cheap GVS fabric.
Keep Local Venule -> Charge Artery -> regional reservoir -> battery/collector recovery hierarchy.
Population Confidence remains the authority for robust answers; restart/reseed/learning mechanisms never authorize an answer by themselves.
MOS transistors are prohibited inside the v14G/v14H/v14J/v14K/v14L/v14M/v14N/v14O/v14P semantic and reasoning core candidate; v14E CMOS remains reference evidence only.
Persistent semantic memory in ordinary semantic cells belongs in sparse connection state, not stored node voltage; temporary excitation charge or transient ionic/filament state is allowed.
Connection plasticity must be reversible: useful relations may strengthen and disproven relations must be able to weaken and later strengthen again.
v14K may recruit a genuinely new semantic relation only through a physically pre-existing dormant candidate connection slot; do not imply that metal wires grow after fabrication.
Repeated unsuccessful effort may increase local eligibility/plasticity but is never evidence that a lesson is true.
After structural learning, remove the teaching signal and replay the unresolved question; transfer/implied-query tests are required before calling the revision understanding.
Uncertain new explanations remain provisional until self-test and/or corroborating evidence supports consolidation.
Hardware redundancy may protect independent device/read/write faults but must not be presented as a solution to common-mode semantic misinformation.
Ordinary SKY130 MIM is an inference-only fixed-connection floor and must never be described as a programmable learning device.
Prefer sparse dormant connection slots over a dense all-to-all rewiring matrix; structural learning has finite capacity and must eventually prune/reuse/allocate slots.
v14L rejects passive one-capacitor fanout as a general communication mechanism; long chains require local energy regeneration.

v14M may use one physical junction type in different operating regimes, but do not claim a single published stack meets all v14M voltage, speed, endurance and memory targets unless it was actually measured that way.

A per-junction MOS compliance limiter, selector or hidden transistor memory in v14M/v14N/v14O/v14P invalidates the semantic-core transistor-elimination claim unless its total system cost is explicitly counted and still wins.
v14N Sparse Regeneration Trunk may reduce active regeneration only across physical transport hops; it must never skip semantic decision/transformation nodes.
v14O guided-gap speed comes from a modeled permanent inert spine + localized field + short final dynamic gap; its speed values are engineering targets, not measured silicon.
v14P long-term route preference is modeled as reversible trapped-charge/polarization around a branch tip, not free charge permanently residing on bare metal.
In v14P, branch use creates eligibility only. Permanent favorable trail requires confirmation/self-test; contradiction must be able to neutralize or reverse the trail.

v14P ordinary semantic cells should prefer roughly 4-5 local candidate branches; wider logical fanout should use hierarchical/shared relay tissue rather than dense local stars unless physical data overturns this result.
The v14P <=1 fF Choice Node is a layout/extraction target only. Do not cite it as achieved parasitic capacitance until a physical layout is extracted.
v14P deliberately decouples long-term learned route state from v14O volatile conduction; do not require the transient bridge filament itself to provide long-retention semantic memory.
Two-copy redundancy is not automatically beneficial; use a voting/redundancy structure only when the failure mathematics improves correctness.
v14M/v14N/v14O/v14P must be judged by total group energy-delay, learning-write amortization, device/process count, routing and yield rather than individual device footprint alone.
Goal Echo remains part of the reasoning hypothesis: forward prompt evidence and reciprocal goal compatibility must be compared against forward-only controls.
CRRO is currently accepted only for exact modular addition in Z_420; do not call it general arithmetic.
Exact transformations remain subproblems inside the broader self-revising connection-memory intelligence fabric rather than the canonical architecture goal.
